purpose: Replace the 20 Tian2020 GR+NFW-deprojected acceleration summaries with source-traceable image-position/redshift catalogs or an equally raw lensing likelihood before any alternative-metric response inference.

acquisition_definition.minimum: Measured strong-lens image positions grouped by source family plus a lens-independent spectroscopic or photometric source-redshift summary. A raw shear catalog with calibration metadata would also qualify.
acquisition_definition.likelihood_ready: The minimum catalog plus declared positional errors/covariance or a rerunnable likelihood definition.
not_sufficient: model-predicted counterimage without an observed counterpart

numeric_outcomes.completed_cycle_outcome: Six of the seven named systems were added from Zitrin et al. 2015. RXJ1532 remains candidate-only, matching the official CLASH release statement that its one multiple-image family is unconfirmed.
numeric_outcomes.stage_advance: All 20 systems have either a local checksum-audited raw/likelihood-level catalog or a primary-source hard-shortfall disposition, with explicit metric-dependence labels.
numeric_outcomes.next_stage_success: Freeze at least ten same systems having measured baryonic profiles plus at least three overlapping radial dynamical constraints and three lensing constraints; every included lens must have an explicit source-redshift likelihood and coordinate covariance that is not borrowed from a fitted GR model.
numeric_outcomes.next_stage_rethink_trigger: After two frozen acquisition cycles, if fewer than ten systems satisfy the same-system overlap rule, stop expanding source names and pre-register either a raw HST/spectroscopic re-reduction for the exact deficit or a smaller identifiable pilot with a formal power/coverage limitation.
